decision_rule: Select H8 value-head-only catch-up only if H7 is a valid same-start fixed-sample FAIL, the fixed mirror signal is positive while critic MSE is the dominant mandatory failure, code evidence proves the KL break removes critic work together with actor work, catch-up can freeze all actor/trunk parameters and buffers, and no closed H3/H4/H5 family has stronger behavior-launch permission.
